name: phd-seminar-after-first-year
description: DGS 2026-10-04 (P1-sheet-9): “Make this a requirement.” §4.2: “Two credits of Research Seminar (CSE 63801 and CSE 63802) are required and expected to be taken during the first year of the program.” The first year is now a deadline — the end of the program’s second semester (Spring 2027 for a Fall 2026 entrant). This student passed CSE 63801 in Fall 2026 but has no CSE 63802 in September 2027, so the row is Overdue rather than merely unmet; a seminar passed after the first year would go to the DGS (tests/seminar-first-year.test.ts).

detailIncludes: §4.2 requires both seminars in the first year of the program
